caveats: CPI-trim and CPI-median are built from seasonally adjusted prices and are revised: since the January 2026 CPI, each January revises the past three years and every other month revises one past month. CPI-common is revised as its factor model is re-estimated on all past data. Today's value for a past month may differ from what was first published: for what was known on a date, use table 18-10-0259 (real-time releases) or wds_get_series_as_of.
